subject: Request: short customer blurb + logo pack for product impact highlight
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@flowmetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:15:00 +0000
Subject: Request: short customer blurb + logo pack for product impact highlight

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the demo last week — FlowMetrics’ work on streaming analytics is exactly the sort of use case we love to highlight. We’re preparing a short “product impact” highlight for the website and an upcoming co-hosted webinar slide deck and wanted to request:

- A one-line customer blurb we can use on the Redwood website (approx. 15–25 words)
- Permission to use the FlowMetrics logo (SVG/PNG) and a short attribution (e.g., “FlowMetrics, Director of Analytics”)
- Any brand guidelines or restrictions we should follow (colors, placement, lockups)

Proposed blurb (feel free to edit):
"Redwood’s inference platform cut our nightly model cost by ~45% while improving average 99th-percentile latency for batch scoring."

If this looks okay from your side, could you loop in whoever owns brand/legal sign-off? Marissa from our marketing team and Jonas (comms) are cc’d — and I’ll add legal if needed.

Happy to share the short layout comps and the specific places we plan to publish. Thanks — appreciate you taking a look.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@flowmetrics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: FlowMetrics Marketing <brand@flowmetrics.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 18:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: short customer blurb + logo pack for product impact highlight

Hi Rafael —

Thanks — glad the demo was useful. I’ve spoken with our comms lead and we’re generally happy to provide a short blurb and logo for marketing. Attaching our current brand guidelines so you can see constraints on usage.

A couple of notes up front:
- We prefer quotes to be attributed to a named person + role and not to include internal metrics that could be considered proprietary (so if the 45% number is sensitive, we may need to soften it).
- Please send the final art/layout before publishing; we’ll do a quick review within 48 business hours.

I’m copying our marketing alias — they’ll provide the logo pack and legal will review the text.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Marketing | FlowMetrics Inc.
marta.ruiz@flowmetrics.com
[Attachment: flowmetrics_brand_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: FlowMetrics Marketing <brand@flowmetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:07:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Request: short customer blurb + logo pack for product impact highlight

Folks — forwarding FlowMetrics’ guidelines and text request. Proposed final quote below, edited slightly to avoid specific internal metric callouts per Marta’s note: 

Proposed quote (for review and legal sign-off):
"Redwood’s inference platform reduced our model serving costs and improved latency for real-time scoring — enabling faster product decisions."

Marketing, can you produce:
- A web hero-sized line and a shortened slide blurb
- A preview of placement on a one-column customer highlight (I’ll attach a mock)

Neha — tagging you for any legal redlines we should route back to FlowMetrics. Let me know if you want me to request an NDA amendment or a short release form.

Thanks,
Rafael

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: short customer blurb + logo pack for product impact highlight

Hi all —

Thanks for sharing the brand guidelines and the proposed quote. From a legal perspective we’re comfortable with the high-level language Rafael proposed, but suggest two small edits to avoid implied guarantees:

- Replace "reduced our model serving costs" with "helped reduce model serving costs"
- Change "improved latency for real-time scoring" to "improved tail latency for real-time scoring in our tests"

I’ve attached a redline with a simple one-paragraph marketing release (one page) that FlowMetrics can sign to grant permission to use the quote and the logo pack. If FlowMetrics prefers to use their own release form, we can accept that as long as it allows use across website, webinar slides, and promotional emails.

Also note: we should confirm the attribution line — ideally a named contact + title (e.g., "Ana Mendes, Director of Analytics, FlowMetrics"). If a title is not allowed, we can attribute to company only.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
[Attachment: redlines_quote_suggestion.docx (DOCX, 12KB)]

Neha, Rafael —

Thanks for the clear edits and the release template. Those changes are acceptable. We’re happy to sign the one-paragraph marketing release as-is. Attaching the approved logo package and a signed PDF of the release.

Final approved quote (as signed):
"Redwood’s inference platform helped reduce our model serving costs and improved tail latency for real-time scoring in our tests — enabling faster product decisions."

Attribution: Ana Mendes, Director of Analytics, FlowMetrics Inc. (permission confirmed)

Please confirm the exact asset filenames you’ll be publishing, and send a final proof prior to live publication (we’ll review within 48 hours).

Thanks and excited to be featured together.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Marketing | FlowMetrics Inc.
marta.ruiz@flowmetrics.com
